jobs.title: Head of Brand & Creative
jobs.description: About Golden Child Golden Child is redefining pet nutrition through an uncompromising focus on health, quality, and culinary craftsmanship. A Miami-based startup, we bring together veterinary nutrition expertise, classically trained chefs, and supply chain specialists to develop food held to human-grade standards. Our chef-crafted, science-backed Mains and functional Drizzles are designed to support lifelong health. We’re building a brand for people whose dogs are family, grounded in the care that goes into their food and the pleasure of the life they share. The Role Golden Child is looking for a Head of Brand & Creative to lead the next chapter of the brand and build the team that brings it to life. You will own Golden Child’s creative direction across packaging, campaigns, content, digital experiences, and physical activations. Your immediate focus will be carrying our evolving brand direction through the rebrand and relaunch, while establishing the creative capabilities we need as the business grows. Our ambition includes packaging people want in their homes, original films that reveal the people and decisions behind our recipes, and experiences that bring dog owners together. You’ll connect those expressions through a recognizable point of view, with food and the relationship between dogs and their people at the center. This is a highly hands-on role. You’ll move between setting brand strategy and shaping the work itself: developing concepts, directing shoots, reviewing packaging proofs, refining copy, and helping the team get projects out into the world. You will work closely with our CMO and founding team, alongside Growth, Culinary, Veterinary Nutrition, Product, and Operations. What You’ll Own 1. Brand Strategy & Creative Direction Own Golden Child’s positioning, visual identity, and tone of voice, translating the brand strategy into clear direction the team can use. jobs.description: Thoughtworks is a global technology consultancy that integrates design, engineering and AI to drive digital innovation. We are over 10,000 people strong across 47 offices in 18 countries. For 30+ years, we’ve delivered extraordinary impact together with our clients by helping them solve complex business problems with technology and culture as the differentiator. jobs.title: Mechanical Design Engineering Team Lead
jobs.description: About pplwise pplwise is a recruiting consultancy for fast-growing technology companies across Europe. Through Recruiting as a Service and Executive Search, we fill key roles for our clients, from start-ups to publicly listed companies. We are filling this position for our client Filics. About our client: Filics Filics is reinventing intralogistics with autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) that change how material moves. Its double-runner system makes Filics the first and only AMR that can drive through load carriers such as Euro pallets. This breaks with forklift logic and sets a new standard for efficiency. Filics is a small, hands-on team that solves hard problems with engineering excellence. Leadership goes to those who take initiative and consistently deliver. As Senior Mechanical Design Engineer (m/f/d) at Filics, you will lead the mechanical design of the robots as they move from prototype to series production. About the role This is an on-site/hybrid role in Munich, close to engineering and assembly. Filics builds its own robot hardware in-house: mechanics, electronics and software. Orders are growing, and the robots are moving from prototypes to series production. Designs that worked in the lab now need to be built reliably, at scale and at the right cost. The hardest problems often sit between disciplines: parts that work on their own can fail once they're assembled with the electronics. The mechanical team has four engineers, most of them at the start of their careers, and they need someone who guides them every day. You'll be the technical lead for the mechanical side of the product and the counterpart to the electronics lead, so the current mechanical manager can focus on core R&D. Your time splits roughly evenly between hands-on engineering and technical leadership. You'll work closely with Electronics, Production, Procurement and the CTO, and you'll set the engineering habits while the team is still small. What you'll do Mentor the mechanical engineers day

jobs.title: Junior Quantum Design Engineer
jobs.description: About Us QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors. With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in! As a Junior Quantum Design Engineer , you will take on a vital, hands-on responsibility in creating our next-generation quantum processors. Your core focus will be centred on the layout, simulation, and verification of quantum processor components and superconducting circuits. Collaborating directly with other design engineers alongside cross-functional R&D teams spanning fabrication, measurement, and system integration, you will transform conceptual device architectures into production-ready designs while closing the feedback loop between theoretical design intent and empirical performance. Your work will be essential as we scale to increasingly complex systems and deliver on the promise of quantum computing. What you'll be doing Design and lay out superconducting circuit components and test structures, such as resonators, qubits, and control lines. Perform electromagnetic and circuit simulations to predict device parameters and optimise designs. Contribute to design verification, including design-rule checks and review of layouts against fabrication process constraints. Compare simulation results with measurement data to validate design models and feed learnings back into future design iterations. Help develop and maintain design tooling, automated layout scripts, and documentation to make our design flow faster and more robust. jobs.description: Product Design Director - Patient (x/f/m) The opportunity Doctolib is a mission-driven healthcare technology company, founded in Paris in 2013. Today, nearly 3,000 people work across Europe to transform the way healthcare is delivered and experienced. More than 500,000 healthcare professionals use Doctolib’s solutions, and the patient app is used by approximately 90 million people across Europe. For patients, Doctolib began as a simple way to find a healthcare professional and book an appointment. We are now building something much more ambitious: an AI-powered Health Companion that helps people navigate care, understand their health and take the right next step throughout their health journey. This means moving beyond a primarily transactional product towards an experience that supports patients before, during and after care, through access to care, health information, patient data, messaging, recommendations, care plans and AI-powered assistance. We are looking for a Product Design Director to help define what this next generation of patient experience should look and feel like. What you will build and lead As Product Design Director, Patient , you will own the design vision and quality bar for Doctolib’s patient experience. You will report to our VP Design and work closely with the Product, Engineering, Medical, Data and Business leadership teams. Your scope will cover the full patient journey, including: access to care, search and booking; patient messaging and teleconsultation; the Patient Health Record and patient context; the app homepage and daily health experience; health content and prevention; recommendations, reminders and care plans; new patient services and subscription experiences; conversational and AI-powered experiences. The current team includes six Senior Product Designers and one Senior Content Designer . jobs.description: About us At Pencil, we are driving innovation in advertising technology through our state-of-the-art SaaS product, which harnesses Agentic AI to redefine content creation.
